description.en:
Basic Attack

Perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG.

Heavy Attack

Consume Stamina to thrust forward, dealing Aero DMG.

Heavy Attack: Windborne Strike

Hold Basic Attack during Heavy Attack to cast Windborne Strike after Heavy Attack ends, dealing Aero DMG.

Heavy Attack: Abyssal Slash

Release Basic Attack during Heavy Attack to cast Abyssal Slash after Heavy Attack ends, dealing Aero DMG.

Mid-Air Attack

Consume Stamina to perform a Plunging Attack while in mid-air, dealing Aero DMG.
After performing the Plunging Attack, use Basic Attack to perform a follow-up attack, dealing Aero DMG.

Mid-Air Attack: Banner of Triumph

After casting Heavy Attack Windborne Strike or Resonance Skill Windqueller in mid-air, Jiyan can perform a mid-air attack, dealing Aero DMG.

Dodge Counter

Use Basic Attack after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Melakukan hingga 5 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Aero DMG.

Heavy Attack

Mengonsumsi Stamina untuk menusuk ke depan, memberikan Aero DMG.

Heavy Attack: Windborne Strike

Tahan Basic Attack saat Heavy Attack untuk melancarkan Windborne Strike setelah Heavy Attack berakhir, memberikan Aero DMG.

Heavy Attack: Abyssal Slash

Lepas Basic Attack saat Heavy Attack untuk melancarkan Abyssal Slash setelah Heavy Attack berakhir, memberikan Aero DMG.

Mid-Air Attack

Mengonsumsi Stamina untuk melakukan Plunging Attack di udara, memberikan Aero DMG.
Setelah Plunging Attack, gunakan Basic Attack untuk melakukan serangan lanjutan yang memberikan Aero DMG.

Mid-Air Attack: Banner of Triumph

Setelah Heavy Attack Windborne Strike atau Resonance Skill Windqueller dilancarkan di udara, Jiyan dapat melakukan serangan di udara yang memberikan Aero DMG.

Dodge Counter

Gunakan Basic Attack setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Aero DMG.

description.en:
Dash forward a certain distance, dealing Aero DMG.

Can be cast in the air.
description.id:
Melesat ke depan sejauh jarak tertentu, memberikan Aero DMG.

Dapat dilancarkan di udara.

description.en:
After releasing Emerald Storm - Prelude, Jiyan enters Qingloong Mode.

Qingloong Mode

Jiyan has increased resistance to interruption.
Basic Attack, Heavy Attack and Dodge Counter are replaced with Heavy Attack Lance of Qingloong.

Heavy Attack: Lance of Qingloong

Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.
description.id:
Setelah Emerald Storm - Prelude dilepaskan, Jiyan memasuki Qingloong Mode.

Qingloong Mode

Jiyan memiliki ketahanan lebih tinggi terhadap interupsi.
Basic Attack, Heavy Attack, dan Dodge Counter digantikan oleh Heavy Attack Lance of Qingloong.

Heavy Attack: Lance of Qingloong

Melakukan hingga 3 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Aero DMG, dianggap sebagai Heavy Attack DMG.

description.en: After casting the Intro Skill Tactical Strike, Jiyan's ATK is increased by 10% for 15s.
description.id: Setelah melancarkan Intro Skill Tactical Strike, ATK Jiyan meningkat sebesar 10% selama 15 dtk.

description.en: When Jiyan's attacks hit a target, Jiyan's Crit. DMG is increased by 12% for 8s.
description.id: Saat serangan Jiyan mengenai target, Crit. DMG Jiyan meningkat sebesar 12% selama 8 dtk.

description.en: Jiyan pierces the target in mid-air, dealing Aero DMG.
description.id: Jiyan menusuk target di udara, memberikan Aero DMG.

description.en:
When casting Resonance Skill Windqueller, if Jiyan has 30 or more "Resolve", he consumes 30 "Resolve" to increase the DMG of this Resonance Skill Windqueller by 20%.
When Jiyan is in Qingloong Mode, DMG of Resonance Skill Windqueller is increased by 20% and no longer consumes "Resolve".

Resonance Liberation: Emerald Storm - Finale

When casting Resonance Liberation Emerald Storm - Prelude, if Jiyan has 30 "Resolve" or more, he will consume 30 "Resolve" to cast Emerald Storm - Finale, dealing Aero DMG, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.
Emerald Storm: Finale can be cast in mid-air at low altitude.

Resolve

Jiyan can hold up to 60 Resolve.
Jiyan gains "Resolve" when his Normal Attack Lone Lance hits the target.
Jiyan gains "Resolve" when the Intro Skill Tactical Strike hits the target.
"Resolve" will gradually decrease if Jiyan does not hit a target within 15s.
description.id:
Saat melancarkan Resonance Skill Windqueller, jika Jiyan memiliki 30 "Resolve" atau lebih, ia mengonsumsi 30 "Resolve" untuk meningkatkan DMG Resonance Skill Windqueller ini sebesar 20%.
Saat Jiyan berada dalam Qingloong Mode, DMG Resonance Skill Windqueller meningkat sebesar 20% dan tidak lagi mengonsumsi "Resolve".

Resonance Liberation: Emerald Storm - Finale

Saat melancarkan Resonance Liberation Emerald Storm - Prelude, jika Jiyan memiliki 30 "Resolve" atau lebih, ia akan mengonsumsi 30 "Resolve" untuk melancarkan Emerald Storm - Finale, memberikan Aero DMG, dianggap sebagai Heavy Attack DMG.
Emerald Storm: Finale dapat dilancarkan di udara pada ketinggian rendah.

Resolve

Jiyan dapat menampung hingga 60 Resolve.
Jiyan mendapat "Resolve" saat Normal Attack Lone Lance mengenai target.
Jiyan mendapat "Resolve" saat Intro Skill Tactical Strike mengenai target.
"Resolve" akan berkurang secara bertahap jika Jiyan tidak mengenai target dalam 15 dtk.

description.en: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.
description.id: Berpeluang menghasilkan hidangan spesial saat memasak.

description.en: When the incoming Resonator's Heavy Attack hits a target, Jiyan will summon a lance to launch a coordinated attack, dealing Aero DMG equal to 313.40% of Jiyan's ATK. This attack lasts for 8s and can be triggered once every 1s, up to 2 times.
description.id: Saat Heavy Attack Resonator yang masuk mengenai target, Jiyan akan memanggil tombak untuk melancarkan serangan terkoordinasi, memberikan Aero DMG sebesar 313,40% ATK Jiyan. Serangan ini berlangsung selama 8 dtk dan dapat dipicu sekali setiap 1 dtk, hingga 2 kali.

description.en: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.
description.id: Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Resonator dapat melancarkan Tune Break pada target.

description.en:
Resonance Skill Windqueller can be used 1 more time.

When casting Resonance Skill Windqueller, the Resolve cost is decreased by 15.
description.id:
Resonance Skill Windqueller dapat digunakan 1 kali lagi.

Saat melancarkan Resonance Skill Windqueller, biaya Resolve berkurang sebesar 15.

description.en: After casting Intro Skill Tactical Strike, Jiyan gains 30 Resolve and his ATK is increased by 28% for 15s. This can be triggered once every 15s.
description.id: Setelah melancarkan Intro Skill Tactical Strike, Jiyan mendapat 30 Resolve dan ATK-nya meningkat sebesar 28% selama 15 dtk. Efek ini dapat dipicu sekali setiap 15 dtk.

description.en: When casting Resonance Skill Windqueller, Resonance Liberation Emerald Storm: Prelude, Resonance Skill Emerald Storm: Finale or Intro Skill Tactical Strike, Jiyan's Crit. Rate is increased by 16% and Crit. DMG is increased by 32% for 8s.
description.id: Saat melancarkan Resonance Skill Windqueller, Resonance Liberation Emerald Storm: Prelude, Resonance Skill Emerald Storm: Finale, atau Intro Skill Tactical Strike, Crit. Rate Jiyan meningkat sebesar 16% dan Crit. DMG meningkat sebesar 32% selama 8 dtk.

description.en: When casting Resonance Liberation Emerald Storm: Prelude or Resonance Liberation Emerald Storm: Finale, the Heavy Attack DMG Bonus of all team members is increased by 25% for 30s.
description.id: Saat melancarkan Resonance Liberation Emerald Storm: Prelude atau Resonance Liberation Emerald Storm: Finale, Heavy Attack DMG Bonus seluruh anggota tim meningkat sebesar 25% selama 30 dtk.

description.en:
Outro Skill Discipline gains an additional DMG Multiplier of 120%.
When Jiyan's attacks hit a target, his ATK is increased by 3% for 8s, stacking up to 15 times; this effect is immediately maxed after he casts Intro Skill Tactical Strike.
description.id:
Outro Skill Discipline mendapat Pengali DMG tambahan sebesar 120%.
Saat serangan Jiyan mengenai target, ATK-nya meningkat sebesar 3% selama 8 dtk, bertumpuk hingga 15 kali; efek ini langsung mencapai maksimum setelah ia melancarkan Intro Skill Tactical Strike.

description.en:
Every time Heavy Attack, Intro Skill Tactical Strike or Resonance Skill Windqueller is used, Jiyan gains 1 stack(s) of "Momentum", stacking up to 2 times.
Resonance Liberation Emerald Storm: Finale will consume all "Momentum", and each stack consumed increases the DMG multiplier of Resonance Liberation Emerald Storm: Finale by 120%.
description.id:
Setiap kali Heavy Attack, Intro Skill Tactical Strike, atau Resonance Skill Windqueller digunakan, Jiyan mendapat 1 stack "Momentum", bertumpuk hingga 2 kali.
Resonance Liberation Emerald Storm: Finale akan mengonsumsi seluruh "Momentum", dan setiap stack yang dikonsumsi meningkatkan pengali DMG Resonance Liberation Emerald Storm: Finale sebesar 120%.
